mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO post_projection_cursor (post_id, last_event_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{postId}, 0, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT last_event_id FROM post_projection_cursor WHERE post_id = #{postId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO post_projection_receipt (event_id, post_id, completed_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{postId}, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM outbox WHERE aggregate_type = 'post' AND type IN ( 'PostContentConfirmed', 'PostMetadataUpdated', 'PostPublished', 'PostTopChanged', 'PostVisibilityChanged', 'PostDeleted' ) AND created_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -5, NOW(3))

SELECT o.id, o.type, o.aggregate_id AS post_id FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN post_projection_receipt r ON r.event_id = o.id WHERE o.aggregate_type = 'post' AND o.type IN ( 'PostContentConfirmed', 'PostMetadataUpdated', 'PostPublished', 'PostTopChanged', 'PostVisibilityChanged', 'PostDeleted' ) AND o.id > #{afterId} AND o.id <= #{throughId} AND o.created_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -5, NOW(3)) AND r.event_id IS NULL ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}
